description.p: USBSID-Configtool is the graphical configuration tool for USBSID-Pico, a Raspberry Pi Pico (RP2040/RP2350) based board for one or two MOS SID chips and/or hardware SID emulators over USB.

ul.li: Predefined and manual socket configurations
Socket chip/SID auto detect
Clock, LED and PCB feature configuration
Clone chip configuration (FPGASID)
Save configs to an INI file and import them back, compatible with cfg_usbsid INI files

description.p: Requires USBSID-Pico firmware 0.5.0-BETA or newer, 0.7.0-BETA or newer is advised.
